[[File:Renta.png|thumb|250px|Renta]] '''Renta''' (Japanese: '''レンタ''' ''Renta'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ036|Mission: Find Oinkologne's Partner!]]''. ==History== Renta lived in [[Pigton Town]] and was a childhood friend and a [[rival]] of [[Yuno]]. When the girl's {{p|Oinkologne}}, [[nickname]]d Twirly, fell in love with his male specimen, Prince, Yuno tried to ask Renta to team up with them for the upcoming [[Pigton Town Multi Battle Tournament]], but he and his Pokémon laughed at her, saying that the female was no match for him. Yuno and Twirly decided, with the help of [[Liko]] and [[Roy]], to bathe Twirly and teach her some etiquette, so that the Pokémon could awaken Prince's feelings. After being snubbed again, Twirly managed to hit Prince with the help of [[Dot's Quaxly]] and peace returned between their {{pkmn|Trainer}}s. However, before leaving, Renta asked Liko and Roy to train together for the competition and, in perfect harmony, the Renta-Yuno duo managed to stand up to the two members of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. During the competition, Renta and Yuno managed to beat all the challengers and thus reach the final, defeating a huge {{p|Mamoswine}} and thus being the winners of the Pigton Town Multi Battle Tournament. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |nick=Prince |trainer=Renta |pkmn=Oinkologne |type1=Normal |img=Renta Prince.png |cap=Renta's Oinkologne |gender=male |epnum=HZ036 |epname=Mission: Find Oinkologne's Partner! |vajp= |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Oinkologne|Prince}} (Japanese: '''プリンス''' ''Prince'') is Renta's only known Pokémon. Initially, he didn't reciprocate the feelings of Twirly, [[Yuno]]'s female Oinkologne but, after the latter was helped by [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and {{TP|Dot|Quaxly}}, eventually gave in. Later, he teamed up with her in the [[Pigton Town Multi Battle Tournament]], managing to reach the final and winning by defeating a {{p|Mamoswine}}.
